Light pink Shrub.
Registration name: KORfobalt
Exhibition name: Cinderella ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 1992).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Wholesale) in 2006 as 'Cinderella Fairy Tale'.
Introduced in United States by Wayside Gardens in 2008.
rows.Bloom: Pink. None to mild, apple, fruity fragrance. Average diameter 4". Medium to large, very full (41+ petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped, old-fashioned bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Rounded buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, arching, bushy, climbing, upright, well-branched. Medium, glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 4'11" (150cm). Width: 28" (70cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower, garden, landscape or shrub. Can be trained as a climber. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant, very blackspot resistant., susceptible to Mildew. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
